title: Restaurant delivery fees by distance, effective 1 July 2026
text: This delivery fee schedule applies to all restaurant orders in every city we serve with effect from 1 July 2026, and replaces the schedule dated 1 March 2025. The delivery fee depends on the road distance from the restaurant to your delivery address, as calculated by the app at checkout, not on the route the delivery partner actually takes. Up to 3 km the delivery fee is ₹25; from 3 to 6 km it is ₹39; from 6 to 8 km it is ₹55. In Bengaluru and Hyderabad, where the delivery radius goes up to 10 km, orders beyond 8 km pay ₹55 plus ₹8 for each additional km. The fee shown at checkout is locked once the order is placed and is never increased afterwards, even if the partner is rerouted. Orders placed between 11 pm and 6 am carry a separate late-night fee of ₹30, on top of the distance fee. Thali Club members pay no distance fee on restaurant orders above ₹199 within 7 km, but the late-night fee still applies to members. Delivery fees for tiffin plans are included in the plan price and are not charged per meal. GST at 18 percent is charged on the delivery fee and is shown as a separate line on the bill.

title: Restaurant delivery fees by distance, effective 1 March 2025 (superseded)
text: Status: superseded on 1 July 2026 by the current delivery fee schedule. This page is kept for reference so that support agents can explain older bills. Under this schedule the delivery fee was based on road distance from the restaurant: up to 2 km the fee was ₹20; from 2 to 5 km it was ₹35; from 5 to 8 km it was ₹49. Orders beyond 8 km were not accepted in any city. The late-night fee for orders placed between 11 pm and 6 am was ₹25. Thali Club members paid no distance fee on restaurant orders above ₹149 within 5 km. Delivery fees for orders placed before 1 July 2026 but scheduled for delivery on or after that date were charged under this old schedule, because the fee is fixed at the moment of booking. Customers who believe they were charged the new fee on such an order can raise it through Help within 30 days and the difference is refunded to the wallet. The rain surcharge and small-order fee were not part of this schedule and were set by separate notices at the time.

title: Small-order fee, platform fee and surcharges
text: A small-order fee of ₹30 is added when the item subtotal of a restaurant order is below ₹149. The subtotal is counted after restaurant discounts but before coupon codes and wallet credits. The small-order fee is charged to Thali Club members too; membership does not waive it. A platform fee of ₹6 is charged on every restaurant order and is not charged on tiffin plan meals. When heavy rain mode is switched on for a delivery zone, a rain surcharge is added: ₹20 for orders up to 4 km and ₹35 for orders above 4 km. The rain surcharge is shown with an umbrella icon before you pay and applies to members as well, because it is paid in full to the delivery partner. In Bengaluru and Pune only, a peak-hour surcharge of up to ₹15 may apply between 8 pm and 10:30 pm on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays; members do not pay the peak-hour surcharge. Packaging charges are set by each restaurant and passed on unchanged. GST on food is 5 percent and is collected by us on behalf of the restaurant; the platform fee, the small-order fee and all surcharges attract GST at 18 percent.

title: Thali Club membership: price, benefits and cancellation
text: Thali Club is our paid membership. It costs ₹149 per month or ₹1,199 for a 12-month plan, paid upfront. Benefits: no distance delivery fee on restaurant orders above ₹199 within 7 km, an extra 10 percent off up to ₹60 per order at restaurants marked with the Club badge, no peak-hour surcharge, and priority chat support. Members still pay the small-order fee, the rain surcharge, the late-night fee and the platform fee. Benefits do not apply to tiffin plans or to pick-up orders. The membership renews automatically and a reminder is sent 3 days before each renewal. Cancelling a monthly plan stops the next renewal; benefits continue to the end of the current month and the current month is not refunded. Cancelling a 12-month plan works differently: the membership ends on the day you cancel, and you receive a pro-rata refund of ₹99 for each unused full month, paid to the original payment method within 7 working days. Part months are not refunded. A 12-month plan bought with a promotional discount is refunded at the discounted monthly value. One account can hold only one membership, and it cannot be transferred or shared with another phone number.

title: Order cancellation and the late delivery guarantee
text: You can cancel any restaurant order free of charge within 60 seconds of placing it. After 60 seconds, once the restaurant has accepted the order, a cancellation fee of 50 percent of the item value is charged, and once the delivery partner has picked up the order it cannot normally be cancelled and no refund is given. Late delivery guarantee: if your order has not been delivered within 20 minutes after the latest arrival time shown at checkout, you can cancel it from the order screen for a full refund, including delivery fees and taxes, even if the food has already been picked up. The guarantee does not apply when heavy rain mode is on, to scheduled orders, or when the delay is caused by a wrong address, a changed address or a customer who could not be reached. If you choose to wait instead of cancelling, you receive ₹50 in promotional wallet credit once the late order is delivered. For prepaid orders, refunds from a cancellation follow the refund rules, which credit the wallet by default. For cash on delivery orders, a cancellation fee is added to your next order, and two cancelled or refused cash orders within 90 days switch off cash on delivery for the account.

title: Refund methods and timelines
text: All refunds on prepaid orders, whether from a cancellation, a missing item or an approved claim, are credited to your in-app wallet by default within 2 hours. This is the default even if you paid by credit card or UPI. If you would rather have the money back on the original payment method, choose refund to source in Help within 48 hours of the wallet credit; after 48 hours the amount stays in the wallet. Refund to source timelines are: UPI within 2 working days, net banking 5 to 7 working days, and debit and credit cards 7 to 10 working days. Once a refund to source is processed we share a reference number in the app that you can give to your bank. Refunds under ₹20 are always credited to the wallet and cannot be sent to source. For cash on delivery orders the refund goes to the wallet, or to a UPI ID you give us, which takes up to 3 working days. Membership refunds are the only exception to the wallet default and always go to the original payment method. Refunds are never paid in cash by delivery partners.

title: Wallet credits: types, use and expiry
text: The wallet holds two kinds of credit. Refund credits come from cancellations, missing items and approved claims. Promotional credits come from cashback offers, late delivery compensation and goodwill gestures. Refund credits expire 180 days after the date they are credited, and promotional credits expire 30 days after they are credited unless the offer states a shorter period. A reminder is sent by SMS and app notification 7 days before any credit expires, and expired credits cannot be reinstated by support. Wallet credits are applied automatically at checkout unless you switch this off on the payment screen. Refund credits can pay for the full order value, but promotional credits can cover at most 20 percent of the item subtotal of any one order. Wallet credits can be used for restaurant orders and tiffin plans but not to buy or renew a Thali Club membership. The maximum wallet balance is ₹10,000; refunds that would take you above this limit are sent to the original payment method instead. Wallet balances cannot be transferred to another account and cannot be withdrawn to a bank account, except through the refund to source option available within 48 hours of a refund.

title: Payment methods and cash on delivery rules, effective 1 August 2026
text: Orders can be paid by UPI, debit or credit card, net banking or wallet credits, or by cash on delivery. These rules replace the cash on delivery rules of 2024, which allowed cash orders up to ₹3,000. Cash on delivery is available for restaurant orders with a total bill of up to ₹2,000. It is not available for tiffin plans, for scheduled orders, or for orders placed between 11 pm and 6 am. Cash on delivery means cash only: delivery partners are not allowed to accept UPI, cards or any personal payment link at the door. If you would like to pay digitally after choosing cash, use the Pay now button on the order screen before the partner arrives, which converts the order to prepaid. Partners carry change for up to ₹200, so please keep smaller notes ready for larger bills. Cash on delivery is switched off for 90 days on any account with two cancelled or refused cash orders within 90 days, and it is not offered to new accounts until the first prepaid order has been delivered. Card payments made through the app carry no extra fee, and international cards are accepted only in Bengaluru and Kochi.

title: Missing, wrong or spilled items: how to claim
text: Report a missing item or a wrong item through Help within 2 hours of delivery. Report a spill, leak or damaged packaging within 30 minutes of delivery, with at least one photo that shows the packaging as it arrived and the affected food. Claims for spills without a photo, or reported after 30 minutes, are not accepted. Approved claims are refunded as follows: a missing or wrong item is refunded at the item price plus its share of taxes and packaging; a spill is refunded for the affected items only, unless the tamper-proof seal on the bag was broken, in which case the whole order is refunded. Claims above ₹500 are checked by a person and decided within 24 hours; smaller claims are usually decided automatically. All claim refunds follow the refund rules and are credited to the wallet by default. Complaints about taste, spice level or portion size are not refundable, but they are passed to the restaurant and a goodwill credit of up to ₹75 may be given. Accounts that make more than 4 claims within 30 days are reviewed manually before further claims are approved.

title: Home tiffin plans for residential addresses
text: Home tiffin plans deliver home-style meals to residential addresses in Pune, Bengaluru and Indore. Meals are delivered Monday to Saturday; there is no delivery on Sundays. A weekly plan of 6 lunches costs ₹720 for vegetarian and ₹900 for non-vegetarian meals, and a monthly plan of 24 meals costs ₹2,640 for vegetarian and ₹3,360 for non-vegetarian. Plans can be lunch only, dinner only or both. Lunch is delivered between 12 noon and 1:30 pm and dinner between 7:30 pm and 9 pm. To skip a lunch, skip it in the app by 9 pm on the previous day; to skip a dinner, skip it by 11 am on the same day. Meals skipped before the cutoff are not charged and extend the plan end date by one meal; meals skipped after the cutoff are charged in full. A monthly plan allows up to 6 skips. You can also pause a plan for up to 10 consecutive days once per plan. If you cancel a home plan, unused meals are refunded to the wallet minus a ₹99 cancellation charge.

title: Office tiffin plans for workplace addresses
text: Office tiffin plans deliver lunch to workplace addresses in Pune, Bengaluru and Indore, Monday to Friday only, and meals are left at the reception or the pantry desk. A plan of 20 lunches costs ₹2,300 for vegetarian and ₹2,900 for non-vegetarian meals. Lunch is delivered between 12:30 pm and 1:30 pm. To skip a lunch on an office plan, skip it in the app by 8 am on the same day. Meals skipped before the cutoff are not charged and extend the plan end date; meals skipped after the cutoff are charged in full. An office plan allows up to 8 skips, and public holidays declared by the state are skipped automatically without counting towards that limit. Office plans cannot be paused; instead, use skips. Dinner is not offered on office plans. If you cancel an office plan, unused meals are refunded to the wallet minus a ₹149 cancellation charge. A home plan and an office plan can run on the same account at the same time, but each needs its own delivery address and is billed separately.

title: Service cities, delivery radius and late-night hours
text: Restaurant delivery is available in Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi and Indore. The maximum distance between the restaurant and your address depends on the city: 7 km in Pune, 10 km in Bengaluru, 10 km in Hyderabad, 6 km in Kochi and 6 km in Indore. Restaurants further away than this are hidden from your search results. Ordering hours also vary by city. In Pune, orders are accepted from 6 am to 1 am. In Hyderabad and Bengaluru, orders are accepted from 6 am to 2 am, and in the Koramangala, Indiranagar and HSR Layout zones of Bengaluru delivery runs 24 hours. In Kochi, orders are accepted from 7 am to 12:30 am, and in Indore from 7 am to midnight. Orders placed between 11 pm and 6 am carry the late-night fee in every city. During heavy rain mode the radius in any city may be reduced to 4 km for safety. Tiffin plans are only available in Pune, Bengaluru and Indore. Pick-up orders, where you collect the food from the restaurant yourself, are available in all five cities at no delivery fee.

title: Scheduled orders and tipping
text: Scheduled orders can be placed up to 2 days in advance, in 30-minute delivery slots between 8 am and 10 pm. Scheduled orders must be prepaid, and the price and fees at the time of booking are locked. A scheduled order can be cancelled free of charge until 45 minutes before the start of its slot; after that it cannot be cancelled and no refund is given. Scheduled orders are not covered by the late delivery guarantee, but if one arrives more than 30 minutes after the end of its slot you receive ₹75 in promotional wallet credit. Tipping: you can add a tip of ₹10, ₹20 or ₹30, or a custom amount up to ₹200, at checkout or from the order screen until the delivery partner has picked up the order. Once the order is picked up a tip cannot be added or changed, and there is no option to tip after delivery; you can rate and compliment the partner instead. The full tip goes to the delivery partner. If an order is cancelled before pickup, the tip is refunded along with the rest of the order.

title: Allergen and dietary labels on menus
text: Every dish on a restaurant menu carries a vegetarian, non-vegetarian or contains-egg marker. In addition, restaurants must tag eight allergens where present: peanuts, tree nuts, milk, gluten, egg, soy, fish or shellfish, and sesame. Allergen tags are shown in red under the dish name and in the dish details. A "may contain traces" note is added when a restaurant prepares the dish in a kitchen that also handles peanuts or tree nuts. A Jain tag means the dish is made without onion, garlic, potatoes or other root vegetables. All labels are declared by the restaurant itself and are checked by our team in a quarterly audit, not for each order. Allergy requests written in the cooking instructions box are passed to the restaurant but are not guaranteed, and a claim cannot be made because a cooking instruction was not followed. If a dish contained one of the eight tagged allergens that was not declared on the menu, you receive a full refund of the order and the dish is removed until the restaurant corrects its label. Customers with severe allergies are advised to contact the restaurant before ordering.

title: Contacting your delivery partner and escalating complaints
text: You can call your delivery partner from the order screen once the partner has picked up the order, and until 10 minutes after delivery. Calls go through a masked number, so neither side sees the other's real phone number, and calls are recorded for safety and quality. You can also send preset chat messages to the partner, such as gate codes. Chat support is available 24 hours a day in the app, and phone support on 1800 309 4455 is open from 8 am to 11 pm. If a complaint is not resolved by chat or phone within 72 hours, you can escalate it to the Grievance Officer from the Help section, quoting your ticket number. The Grievance Officer acknowledges every escalation within 48 hours and gives a final decision within 15 days. Escalations about safety, harassment or a partner's behaviour skip the 72-hour wait and are passed to the Grievance Officer at once. Our Grievance Officer is based at the Pune head office, and written complaints can also be posted there. Customers who are not satisfied with the final decision may approach the consumer commission for their district.
